player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga go na sebopego sa sephethephethe se hweditšwego. Šomiša '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Plelere {player_id}, Seko sa tshepele. Kolonne {col} ke ntle le mabapi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lenaneo la mokgobo {pile_index} le ka ntle ga lefelo.
invalid_move.non_positive: O swanetše go tloša bonyenyane selo se tee.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Ga go na le tokelo ya go tshepa {quantity} go tswa mo pile {pile_index} (go sala {pile_count} pele).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Sebapadi {player_id} se tšere selo sa mafelelo!
